company.name: Carta
company.shortDescription: Carta is a global ownership management platform that helps companies, investors, and employees manage equity and ownership.
company.description: Carta is a transfer agent for private companies that enables seed-stage to pre-IPO companies to manage equity electronically with the participation of their shareholders, employees, auditors, and legal counsel. It digitizes paper stock certificates along with stock options, warrants, and derivatives to create a real-time image of who owns what at a startup.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based platform for managing company equity, ownership records, fundraising transactions, valuations, employee compensation, liquidity events, and related compliance workflows.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $400,000, or 0.03% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 13 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $40,236,198 to $7,400,000,000, a 183.91x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 76 (-14 over 90 days) and market heat at 52 (-22).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
